headline: Nancy Guthrie 💸💀 Ransom TXT GOES VIRAL 📱🔥 - Cops BEG PUBLIC 🗣️ to SPOT WRITER ✍️
text:
Arizona 5-0 🚔🔍 just dropped Nancy Guthrie's 💰📜 ransom TXT's hoping the public 👀🧠 will ID the kidnapper ✍️🕵️‍♂️. The first note 😳📱 demanded $4M BTC 💸🪙 before 5PM Thursday the 5th, or the price jumps to $6M 💰📈 by Monday the 9th. "She is safe but scared 😰," the note began, warning no NEGOTIATION 🚫🤝 and that law enforcement CAN'T HELP 🛑🚓.

The second note 🥀📜 dropped four days later claiming Nancy, 84 🧓💔, died from a HEART issue 💔 shortly after the snatch, saying "we are truly sorry 😔🙏" and she is "buried in nature 🌲🪦."

Pima County Sheriff 🐷🚨 says they CAN'T confirm her death ☠️🔍 and the case is still OPEN 👐. They hope "distinct linguistic characteristics" 🗣️🔍 will ring a bell for a friend, family, or coworker 🤔👥. Nancy vanished from her Tucson home 🏠 after relatives dropped her off on January 31st 📅, last seen wearing a WHITE SMART WATCH ⌚ and the backyard flood light was smashed 💡💥.

Savannah Guthrie 📺💫, the TODAY show queen 👑, posted on IG 📲 begging the abductors to "do the right thing" 🥺🙏 and drop the location pin 📍. "We will pay," she promised 💰💸. A masked suspect was caught on her mom's RING camera 🎥😷, but a glove found nearby gave ZERO DNA 🧤❌.

Cops say a pal, classmate, or acquaintance might recognize the writer's style 📝🔍 - just like Ted Kaczynski's bro ratted him out after the Unabomber manifesto went public 📜👀. The investigation is still active 🔎🚨 and investigators are pleading for the public to come forward 🗣️🤝 before this case goes COLD 🥶❄️.
